successCriteria.description: The `ILeaveRequestService` interface exposes all 9 methods: `create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto)`, `submit(id: string)`, `approve(id: string, approverId: string)`, `reject(id: string, approverId: string)`, `cancel(id: string, cancelledBy: string)`, `update(id: string, dto: UpdateLeaveRequestDto)`, `getById(id: string)`, `query(params: LeaveRequestQueryParams)`, `getEmployeeRequests(employeeId: string)` — each returning `Promise<LeaveRequest>` (or `Promise<LeaveRequest[]>` for query/getEmployeeRequests).

`create` validates employee is ACTIVE (via `IEmployeeService.getById`), policy is active (via `ILeavePolicyService.getById`), `endDate >= startDate`, and creates the request in DRAFT status — throwing `ValidationError` for any violation.

`submit` transitions only from DRAFT; validates employee active, policy active; checks minimumNoticeDays (skipped when `policy.leaveType === LeaveType.EMERGENCY`); detects overlapping requests via `findOverlapping` and throws `ConflictError`; computes `daysRequested = (endDate - startDate) + 1` (inclusive calendar days, integer); checks sufficient balance via `ILeaveBalanceService.getRemainingDays` using `startDate.getFullYear()` as fiscal year; throws `ValidationError` on insufficient balance.

`approve` transitions only from SUBMITTED; deducts days from LeaveBalance via `ILeaveBalanceService.deductDays` using the inclusive formula; sets `approvedBy`, `approvedAt`, `status=APPROVED`; throws `ValidationError` for invalid state transition.
